title.narrative: UN Women: Response & Mgm of Refugee crisis in context of war in Ukraine 2022
UNW: Response & Mgm of Refugee crisis in context of war in Ukraine 2022

description.narrative:
Prioritet för UN Women är att ge stöd i den övergripande flyktinginsatsen som leds av UNHCR, men samtidigt engagera sig från början av kopplingen mellan det humanitära biståndet och utvecklingen. För detta ändamål bedömde UN Women de behov och utmaningar som nationella kvinnoorganisationer står inför för att kunna svara på flyktingkrisen och samtidigt engagera sig med lokala myndigheter och värdsamhällen.
Resultat 1: Kvinnor (flyktingar, fördrivna och värdlandsmedborgare) bidrar till och drar nytta av omedelbara reaktioner i kris på sätt som bygger deras motståndskraft och gör det möjligt för dem att uppnå mer rättvisa relationer, fria från våld.
Resultat 2: Kvinnor och flickor från Moldavien drar nytta av anständigt arbete, inkomsttrygghet och socioekonomisk utveckling.

Priority for UN Women is to provide support in the overall refugee response led by UNHCR, but at the same time engage as of the onset of the nexus between the humanitarian assistance and development. For this purpose, UN Women assessed the needs and challenges national women’s organizations face to be able to respond to the refugee crisis and at the same time engage with local governments and host communities.
Outcome 1: Women (refugee, displaced and host country nationals) contribute to, and benefit from immediate response in crisis in ways that build their resilience and make it possible for them to attain more equitable relationships, free from violence.
Outcome 2: Women and girls from Moldova benefit from decent work, income security and socio-economic development.

description.narrative:
In total, 495 refugees (211 women, 138 girls and 146 boys) arriving from Ukraine on the left bank of the river Nistru benefited from immediate and direct support in the form of product packages and baby nutrition, hygienic packages, and medicines under the partnership with the Center for Support and Development of Civic Initiatives Resonance.
As part of the same support, a total of 879 specialised services were provided by social workers (365 consultations), psychological counselling (46 consultations), legal aid (15) and information support and referral for 453 refugees.
53 Ukrainian refugees (out of which 24 women (aged 22 to 68 years) and 12 children (aged from 6 months to 17 years) accommodated within Carpineni refugee shelter have benefited from essential support and humanitarian aid, being provided with essential kitchen goods as well as personal hygiene goods due to the Swedish contribution of financial support under the reported project.
About 324,000 internet users were reached by the "Break the Silence! We stand by you" campaign organized by UN Women in partnership with UNFPA, UNHCR, and UNICEF, with the support of the Ministry of Labour and Social Protection (November 2022- April 2023). During the campaign, information was shared on how to prevent and combat gender-based violence and on the services available in the Republic of Moldova for survivors of violence.
More than 1,500 people, including Ukrainian refugees, participated in five outdoor events that were organized in the centre, north and south of Moldova. Guests at the events were able to attend information sessions with doctors, lawyers and psychologists who spoke about the phenomenon of gender-based violence and the services available in Moldova for survivors of all forms of violence.
In total, 323.784 people were reached by an extensive SMM campaign carried out on the Facebook page of the Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of the Republic of Moldova and all the partner UN agencies.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
